speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Health whether Singapore's healthcare system has a plan for mobilising and coordinating all healthcare resources in case of a mass casualty incident that is similar to France's national emergency response plan "Plan Blanc".

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: So, is that kind of study being done of the experience of other cities?

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: With regards to studying other countries, the short answer is, yes, we do.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Just last year, I was in London to study some of the practices as well as in Israel.
